originalTitle: When Amgen's Forecast And Chart Say The Same Thing, Pay Attention
summary: Amgen (AMGN) raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2026 on August 4. Since the market close before that release, the stock has gained 15.2%, outpacing the 1.9% return of the S&P 500. A higher forecast or a climbing share price means little in isolation. When the corporate numbers and the technical chart align, however, the combination warrants closer scrutiny. So how far did management raise its forecast, and why.
content:
Amgen (AMGN) raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2026 on August 4. Since the market close before that release, the stock has gained 15.2%, outpacing the 1.9% return of the S&P 500. A higher forecast or a climbing share price means little in isolation. When the corporate numbers and the technical chart align, however, the combination warrants closer scrutiny. So how far did management raise its forecast, and why?

Management now expects fiscal 2026 revenue to reach $38.8 billion at the midpoint of its new range, up from $37.8 billion in the previous forecast. The revision represents a 2.6% raise. Adjusted earnings per share, management’s own measure, climbed to $22.90 at the midpoint, up from $22.40. Nothing in the release was guided lower. Forecasts for capital spending and share buybacks remained unchanged.

Six drugs that management counts as its main growth drivers collectively grew 26% from a year earlier. They accounted for nearly 70% of product sales in the quarter ended June. Repatha, a cholesterol-lowering drug, grew 37% to $953 million.

This expansion had to cover weakness among older drugs. Prolia and XGEVA collectively sold 33% less than a year earlier as biosimilar copies launched, a development management had expected. Total revenue still rose 10%. Newer drugs more than made up the difference, providing the foundation for the higher forecast.

When Amgen is a large share of what you own, your plan rides on management delivering its forecast. See how to protect a concentrated position .

Amgen’s share price closed at $434.03 on October 15, holding 4.9% above its 50-day average, which tracks the average closing price over the last 50 trading days. The stock sits 18.9% above its 200-day average, the equivalent measure over 200 trading days. The 50-day average currently rests above the 200-day average. On both measures, the uptrend remains intact.

Shares rose 7.6% in the two sessions surrounding the release, outperforming a 1.6% gain for the S&P 500. The move priced the quarter’s results and the new forecast together. The stock has added 7.0% since then, while the broader index has barely moved. The climb has not been entirely smooth, however. The shares fell 10.1% in a single session on September 8.

Is There Room Left To Run In Amgen Stock?

Amgen can grow more slowly in the second half of the year and still meet its raised range. Revenue for the first half of fiscal 2026 reached $18.7 billion, up 7.8% from a year earlier. Reaching the midpoint requires $20.1 billion in the last two quarters. That target represents a 3.6% increase over the same quarters of 2025.

New trial evidence also supports Repatha. On August 31, Amgen reported that the drug reduced the risk of death in high-risk adults who had never experienced a heart attack or stroke. Management noted that more than 1 million people in the U.S. currently take Repatha, and tens of millions more could benefit.

On the other hand, management said operating expenses would rise meaningfully in the third quarter from the second. The increase includes a $100 million upfront payment for a business deal. The stock also trades at 26.8 times its last twelve months of reported earnings, compared with 22.7 for the S&P 500. Amgen’s next report is expected on or around November 3.

So far, the raised forecast comes from drugs that are still growing quickly, and the share price sits above both averages. The open questions are whether the last two quarters will bring in the $20.1 billion required for the midpoint, and whether Repatha alongside the other growth drugs will keep adding more sales than the older drugs lose. A second half that falls short, or a share price slipping back under its 50-day average, would mean the forecast and the chart no longer agree. Amgen’s September-quarter revenue remains the number to watch.

Is Too Much Of Your Wealth Riding On One Stock?

Amgen holders are relying on a forecast that management still has to deliver. When one position grows into a large part of your wealth, a sharp fall can hurt your whole plan, and selling to spread the money out can bring a large tax bill. Glenn Caldicott, CIO of our Boston-based partner firm Empirical Asset Management, an SEC-registered investment adviser, offers a free 15-minute strategy review of ways to protect a concentrated position and unwind it with less tax.
chineseTitle: 当安进的预测和图表说同样的话时，请注意
chineseSummary: 安进公司 (AMGN) 于 8 月 4 日上调了 2026 财年的营收预期。自该消息发布前收盘以来，该股已上涨 15.2%，超过标准普尔 500 指数 1.9% 的回报率。单独而言，更高的预期或股价上涨并没有什么意义。然而，当公司数据和技术图表一致时，这种组合就值得更仔细的审查。那么管理层将其预测提高了多少以及原因。
chineseContent:
安进公司 (AMGN) 于 8 月 4 日上调了 2026 财年的营收预期。自该消息发布前收盘以来，该股已上涨 15.2%，超过标准普尔 500 指数 1.9% 的回报率。单独而言，更高的预期或股价上涨并没有什么意义。然而，当公司数据和技术图表一致时，这种组合就值得更仔细的审查。那么管理层将预测提高了多少，为什么？

管理层目前预计 2026 财年收入将达到新区间中点的 388 亿美元，高于之前预测的 378 亿美元。此次修订意味着上调 2.6%。管理层自行衡量的调整后每股收益从 22.40 美元攀升至中点 22.90 美元。新闻稿中没有任何内容被引导降低。资本支出和股票回购的预测保持不变。

管理层认为其主要增长动力的 6 种药物同比增长 26%。截至 6 月份的季度，它们的产品销售额占近 70%。 Repatha 是一种降胆固醇药物，销售额增长 37%，达到 9.53 亿美元。

这种扩张必须弥补旧药的弱点。开发管理层预计，随着生物仿制药的推出，Prolia 和 XGEVA 的总销量比一年前下降了 33%。总收入仍增长10%。较新的药物足以弥补这一差异，为更高的预测奠定了基础。

当安进（Amgen）在您拥有的资产中占有很大份额时，您的计划就取决于管理层提供的预测。看看如何保护集中位置。

安进股价 10 月 15 日收于 434.03 美元，较 50 日均线（追踪过去 50 个交易日的平均收盘价）高出 4.9%。该股较 200 日平均水平（相当于 200 个交易日的平均水平）高出 18.9%。 50 日均线目前位于 200 日均线上方。从这两项指标来看，上升趋势仍然完好无损。

在该消息发布前后的两个交易日中，股价上涨了 7.6%，跑赢了标准普尔 500 指数 1.6% 的涨幅。这一举措将本季度业绩和新预测结合起来。自那时起，该股已上涨 7.0%，而大盘指数几乎没有变动。然而，攀登过程并不完全顺利。 9月8日该股单日下跌10.1%。

安进股票还有运行空间吗？

安进下半年的增长速度可能会更慢，但仍能达到其上调幅度。 2026财年上半年收入达到187亿美元，同比增长7.8%。达到中点需要过去两个季度 201 亿美元。该目标比 2025 年同季度增长 3.6%。

新的试验证据也支持 Repatha。 8 月 31 日，安进报告称，该药物降低了从未经历过心脏病或中风的高危成年人的死亡风险。管理层指出，目前美国有超过 100 万人服用 Repatha，还有数千万人可能受益。

另一方面，管理层表示，第三季度的运营费用将较第二季度大幅上升。增加的金额包括一笔商业交易的 1 亿美元预付款。该股的市盈率为过去 12 个月报告收益的 26.8 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.7 倍。安进的下一份报告预计将于 11 月 3 日左右发布。

到目前为止，上调的预测来自仍在快速增长的药品，且股价高于这两个平均水平。悬而未决的问题是，最后两个季度是否会带来中点所需的 201 亿美元收入，以及 Repatha 与其他生长药物一起增加的销售额是否会继续超过旧药损失的销售额。如果下半年表现不佳，或者股价回落至 50 日均线以下，则意味着预测和图表不再相符。安进九月份季度的收入仍然值得关注。

您的财富是否过多集中在一只股票上？

安进股东所依赖的是管理层仍需兑现的预测。当一个头寸增长到你财富的很大一部分时，急剧下跌可能会损害你的整个计划，而出售以分散资金可能会带来巨额税单。 Glenn Caldicott 是我们位于波士顿的合作伙伴公司 Empirical Asset Management（一家在 SEC 注册的投资顾问）的首席信息官，他提供了 15 分钟的免费策略审查，介绍如何保护集中头寸并以更少的税收解除头寸。
